gloss: comfort (of a place); how comfortable one feels somewhere

definitions.gloss: comfort (of a place); feeling of ease in an environment
definitions.explanation: How comfortable or at ease one feels in a particular place or environment.

examples.japanese: このカフェは{居心地|いごこち}がいい。
examples.english: This café has a comfortable atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {居心地|いごこち}の{悪|わる}い{場所|ばしょ}だ。
examples.english: It's an uncomfortable place to be.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{家|いえ}は{居心地|いごこち}が{良|よ}くて{長居|ながい}してしまった。
examples.english: His house was so comfortable that I ended up staying longer than planned.

notes:
{居心地|いごこち} combines {居|い}る (to be somewhere) and ⟦{心地|ここち}→心地：12568_kokochi⟧ (feeling): how it feels to be in a place. It covers both physical comfort and the social atmosphere.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {居心地|いごこち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ / ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧ (comfortable, cozy)
- {居心地|いごこち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (uncomfortable, awkward)
- {居心地|いごこち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧ (a comfortable place)

USAGE:
{居心地|いごこち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ usually says more about the people than the furniture — it is the standard way to describe feeling unwelcome or out of place in a room.

- ⟦{着心地|きごこち}→着心地：07269_kigokochi⟧ (wearing comfort)
